content.text: This guide is for digital creators in Nigeria, who can't collect payment through Stripe due to country restrictions. With COREMERCH's Sovereign Infrastructure, you can deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, accept crypto payments, and maintain ownership of your data. By following this [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-what-2|COREMERCH guide to github]].io/store/blog/nonsense-guide-building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-full|[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nonsense-guide-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-2|The No-Nonsense]]]] guide, you'll learn how to set up a reliable and scalable digital store without relying on platforms that can shut you down. You'll also discover the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 and why Edge Commerce Stack is the ultimate solution for serious digital creators.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are not designed for digital creators in restricted countries. They can shut you down at any time, taking your store and earnings with them. In contrast, COREMERCH's Sovereign Infrastructure is built specifically for digital creators who need a reliable and scalable payment solution. By deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll be in control of your own infrastructure, with no dependence on third-party platforms. This means you can focus on creating and selling your digital products without worrying about platform restrictions or shutdowns.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your digital store, you'll need to sign up for a Cloudflare account and create a new site on Cloudflare Pages. You'll also need to set up a NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments. Additionally, you'll need to create a new Google Drive folder to store your digital products and a Google Sheets spreadsheet to manage your orders. Once you have these basic components set up, you can start building your digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments. You'll also need to set up a Cloudflare Worker to handle payment notifications and update your Google Sheets spreadsheet accordingly. Finally, you'll need to set up a Cloudflare Page to serve your digital products and a Google Drive folder to store them. This will ensure that your customers can purchase and download your digital products seamlessly.
COREMERCH's Sovereign Infrastructure is built specifically for digital creators in restricted countries.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. To do this, you'll need to deploy your Cloudflare Pages site and test your payment flow using the NOWPayments demo environment. Once you've tested and validated your payment flow, you can switch to the live environment and start processing real transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your digital store is easy with COREMERCH's Sovereign Infrastructure. To scale, you'll need to upgrade your Cloudflare Pages site to a paid plan and configure your NOWPayments account to handle increased traffic. You'll also need to set up a Cloudflare Cache to improve performance and a Cloudflare Firewall to protect against DDoS attacks. Additionally, you'll need to configure your Google Sheets spreadsheet to handle increased order volume and set up a Cloudflare Page to serve your digital products more efficiently.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question a reader would ask is: Can I trust COREMERCH's Sovereign Infrastructure to process my crypto payments reliably? The answer is yes. COREMERCH has been pressure-tested against actual payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation, and has a proven track record of success. With Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages in 48 hours, with end-to-end testing and 30-day support. This means you can focus on creating and selling your digital products without worrying about payment processing or platform restrictions.
Deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages can be done for free with COREMERCH's Sovereign Infrastructure.

This comprehensive solution includes everything you need to deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages in 48 hours, including Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Additionally, you can visit the COREMERCH Shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about the Edge Commerce Stack and other COREMERCH products.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, follow these concrete steps: Set up a Cloudflare account and create a new site on Cloudflare Pages. Sign up for a NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments. Create a new Google Drive folder to store your digital products and a Google Sheets spreadsheet to manage your orders. Configure your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments and set up a Cloudflare Worker to handle payment notifications. Deploy your Cloudflare Pages site and test your payment flow using the NOWPayments demo environment. Switch to the live environment and start processing real transactions.

What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 is a basic digital store setup on Cloudflare Pages, while Stack 02 is a more advanced setup that includes Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Stack 02 is designed for serious digital creators who need a scalable and reliable payment solution.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages, but COREMERCH recommends using Cloudflare Pages for its scalability and reliability.
